resolved_findings.title: Ignored repository-root modules bypass the pinned runner source check
resolved_findings.first_evidence: verify_source restricts ls-tree and unexpected-module scanning to ('app', 'scripts').
resolved_findings.why_it_matters: The pinned entry script adds the repository root to sys.path[0]. An ignored root-level subprocess.py or json.py can then execute instead of the standard library while HEAD, git status, and the app/scripts blob checks all pass. The configured source SHA therefore does not constrain all code imported by the runner.
evidence: terminal_mcp/fleet_readiness.py:55 verifies only app and scripts blobs; :69-74 scans only those directories.
ProjectFlow scripts/fleet-permissions.py:6 inserts the repository root at sys.path[0], then imports app.services.fleet_permissions, which imports subprocess and json.

Read-only fresh python3 -I check showed importing sys and pathlib does not load subprocess or json, so later imports remain subject to the inserted search path. No source code executed or files written by that check.
resolved_findings.suggested_fix: Constrain the repository-root import surface to verified pinned modules/packages, or isolate project imports so ignored root modules cannot shadow runtime dependencies. Add a fixture with a root-level subprocess.py ignored via .git/info/exclude and prove preflight blocks or the pinned runner cannot import it.
resolved_findings.validation_reason: Final verify_source checks every pinned tree blob and walks all non-hidden root directories, rejecting untracked importable modules and symlinks. The ignored-root-subprocess fixture asserts SOURCE_DIRTY. The reviewer inspected the regression fixture but did not execute it or obtain a separate validator.

resolved_findings.title: Isolation test now requires Linux ip without a capability guard
resolved_findings.why_it_matters: The module only skips when Docker is unavailable. A macOS or Windows Docker host, or Linux installation without iproute2, reaches the new unconditional ip invocation and fails with FileNotFoundError before exercising isolation.
resolved_findings.suggested_fix: Explicitly skip this fixture when Linux route inspection is unavailable, or implement equivalent route discovery on supported platforms. Preserve fail-closed collision checking.
resolved_findings.validation_reason: The fixture now checks sys.platform == linux and presence of ip before invoking route inspection; unsupported hosts explicitly skip. No test execution or separate validator by reviewer.
